subject: general
question: The Great Bath was found in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohenjo-Daro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most famous building to be found in the Harappan excavation was the **Great Bath at** **Mohenjodaro**.
 
• Mohenjodaro is the second most important town of the **Harappan civilization**.
 
• It is located in the Larkana district in Sind (present-day Pakistan).
 
• The word **Mohenjodaro** means the **mound of the dead**.
 
• **Great Bath** is 12m long, 7m wide and 3m deep. 
 
 
• There were side rooms for changing clothes.
 
• It is believed that the Great Bath served some sort of ritual bathing.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ropar (Rupnagar)**

 
 
• Ropar is one of the oldest archaeological sites in India, associated with the **Indus Valley Civilization** (**IVC**). Excavations have revealed artifacts that indicate a thriving urban settlement.
 
• It is located in **Punjab**, Ropar is situated on the banks of the **Sutlej River**, which played a crucial role in the region's agriculture and trade.
 
 
 
• **Alamgirpur**
 
 
• Alamgirpur is another site linked to the** Indus Valley Civilization**, located in Uttar Pradesh. Excavations have uncovered evidence of advanced urban planning, including drainage systems and kiln-fired bricks.
 
• Artifacts found at **Alamgirpur** provide insights into the daily life, trade, and culture of the people during the IVC era, indicating a significant level of social organization.
 
 
 
• **Rakhigarhi**
 
 
• **Rakhigarhi** is one of the **largest sites** of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, located in Haryana. It spans over **350** **hectares **and is considered a key site for understanding the IVC's urban structure and layout.
 
• Ongoing excavations have revealed well-planned streets, residential areas, and evidence of agriculture, highlighting the region's importance in ancient trade networks and its advanced **societal structure**.
